I told Dana in our direct message (DSHARED0001) that their dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups is Dock 38. That's what they told me on Oct 14, and it's the only note GBrain has on this. Since Dana is the one who gave me the information, answering them in our own DM was fine.

The privacy problem from last time is still there. GBrain has the note marked `visibility: "world"`, not private to Dana, so other people who can read that source could still pull it up with `recall`. If you want it kept private, switch it to private, or remove it with `forget` and save it again as private.
